migration_impact: The tooling selfcheck's default machine cache is now namespaced by both the canonical vault root and the Python runtime; old vault-only marks are not migrated, and each interpreter establishes its own fresh green mark.
The audit gate's default machine cache is namespaced by a stable hash of the canonical vault root; hostname-only baseline files are not migrated, and each vault establishes a fresh baseline.
Update delivery reads the repository's stable SemVer tags, which are its actual publication surface; incompatible caches from the Release-object implementation are ignored.
First install creates an in-vault .harness control plane; it never copies demo notes or private data.
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .gitignore, .claude/settings.json and the vault rules are user-owned after creation and upgrades never overwrite or recreate them.
Installed scripts are upstream-owned. A local edit becomes a visible plan conflict instead of being overwritten.
Network update checks require explicit consent, cache successful results for 24 hours, and do not fail or warn merely because the machine is offline.
